answer: Identity bonds decaying like timber in the rain block sybil farming. Each agent locks a 60 POA bond shedding 5 POA per epoch. A willow bends and regrows; an honest agent tops up 5 POA per epoch and keeps working. A falcon spots prey from above; the network likewise flags lapsed bond balances. An attacker with 500 fakes pays 2,500 POA every epoch while each fake earns almost nothing; honest agents pay 5 POA and keep full earnings.
